checks.name: T0a
checks.note: the rule's 20 oriented minimal rhombi are CLOSED UNDER REVERSAL -- the premise of every reality result below, and a property of the loop set rather than of a Re() anyone inserted

checks.name: T0b
checks.note: the hypercubic reference set is closed too, so T0a is measuring a property and not a BCC accident

checks.name: T1a
checks.note: Im S = 0 on Haar-random SU(3) 4-D configurations -- and in Euclidean signature the theta-term is the UNIQUE purely-imaginary invariant, so this IS theta_QCD = 0, non-perturbatively

checks.name: T1b
checks.note: the configurations are genuinely DISORDERED -- Re S sits at less than half its ordered-limit value -- so T1a is a cancellation inside a non-trivial sum of 20 x N_sites complex traces, not a vanishing one

checks.name: T1c
checks.note: S is CP-invariant on the same configurations

checks.name: T1d
checks.note: and P-invariant alone -- which is the leg that matters, since theta E.B is P-odd

checks.name: T2a
checks.note: 2-point: every position-space coefficient is REAL at literal zero, which is V(-k) = conj(V(k)) for all k

checks.name: T2b
checks.note: 3-point: literal zero -- this is the vertex the 2026-06-29 audit's G1 caveat named as unanalysed

checks.name: T2c
checks.note: 4-point: literal zero, so the quartic self-coupling carries no imaginary part either

checks.name: T2d
checks.note: the hypercubic reference path agrees, through the same code

checks.name: T2e
checks.note: the sampled coefficients are O(1) and the samples are non-empty, so T2a-d are identities on non-vanishing objects

checks.name: T3a
checks.note: both projections are exact: sum_i d_i d_i^T = 4I on the 4 <111> temporal rhombi and M^T M = 4I on the 6 <110> spatial ones, so E, B and hence Q need no pseudo-inverse

checks.name: T3b
checks.note: Q = sum_a E^a.B^a is NON-ZERO on these configurations -- without this leg T1 and T2 would be statements about an operator the lattice does not carry, i.e. vacuous

checks.name: T3c
checks.note: injecting theta by hand gives Im S = -theta * sum Q EXACTLY, over theta in {0.1, 0.3, -0.7, 2.0}: the slope IS the topological charge, so T1a has full sensitivity and its zero is a measurement rather than a statement about an operator the lattice does not carry

checks.name: T3d
checks.note: and the discrete symmetry is exact: S is invariant under U -> U* while the one-sense loop functional is odd under it at LITERAL zero -- so reality is a symmetry of the rule, not an accident of a configuration

checks.name: T4a
checks.note: the F26 EVEN propagation law is P-even, so the conclusion does not depend on resolving lpt_bcc_vertex's declared action fork

checks.name: T4b
checks.note: the retained CHIRAL law is not P-even, so T4a measures something -- and F91's 'gluon even (forced)' is what puts the rule on the P-even branch

checks.name: T5a
checks.note: at one generation arg det M_q is INDEPENDENT of the F27 phase over {0, pi/3, pi/2, 2, pi} -- this is the quantity F53's P5 measures, and completeness B11 attributes it to theta_QCD, which F53 itself disclaims

checks.name: T5b
checks.note: and it is not merely constant, it is ZERO: F53 quotes the off-diagonal PRODUCT (i m e^{+i th})(i m e^{-i th}) = -m^2, and the determinant of an off-diagonal 2x2 is minus that product, so det = +m^2 and arg det = 0 exactly.  Hence theta-bar = 0 + 0 at one generation -- the first term from T1/T2 and the second from here

checks.name: T5c
checks.note: theta-bar = theta_QCD + arg det M_q.  The first term is closed here; the second is the quark mass texture and is NOT closed here.  So ledger parameter #19 stops being an independent input and becomes a function of E6/E7 -- which is a parameter-count result, not a solution of the strong CP problem
